column1: # UNGRADABLE.tsv -- gnu_prolog: the shipped source files the ONE oracle (gprolog, lib_oracle_flags.sh gprolog_bin) gives no answer
# for, so no driver's ref can be cut from it. name<TAB>CLASS<TAB>the oracle's reason, measured 2026-10-10 by the coo (row prolog-gnu-
# every-prolog-source-file-...-ceo-1312). Each stays in the shipped denominator as debt (CEO-749, CEO-1286, CEO-1588 (a)); none is
# EXCLUDED. A reason states what gprolog did, never what any other system did (lib_inventory.sh ARM 6).
# 2026-10-10 (coo): re-measured under gprolog 1.6.0, the oracle since CEO-1598 -- it makes redefining a built-in a fatal compile error, so
# the four pl2wam host shims (compat, sicslib, swilib, yaplib) join; their 1.4.5 drivers are removed.

column3: gprolog 1.6.0 (gprolog_bin since CEO-1598) refuses to compile it: foreign.pl:45 fatal error, redefining built-in predicate '$force_foreign_link'/0, compilation failed (1.4.5 failed it at foreign.pl:50-52, '$call_c'/1 not allowed in this mode)

the stub GNU links when line editing is configured out; gprolog 1.6.0 links le_interf.pl in its place and refuses to compile this one: no_le_interf.pl:41 fatal error, redefining built-in predicate '$use_le_interf'/0, compilation failed -- no oracle run executes this file's code

the stub GNU links when sockets are configured out; gprolog 1.6.0 links sockets.pl in its place and refuses to compile this one: no_sockets.pl:41 fatal error, redefining built-in predicate '$use_sockets'/0, compilation failed -- no oracle run executes this file's code

the interactive top level (top_level/0, break/0 and the query loop under them) reads its queries from the terminal; measured 2026-10-10 on gprolog 1.4.5 and again on 1.6.0, break/0 with its standard input at end of file opens a new break level without end ({Break Level 1} to {Break Level 1253} in 10 s on 1.4.5, then killed), so no fixed standard input gives the oracle an answer to cut

the Ciao Prolog shim of pl2wam; gprolog 1.6.0 refuses to compile it: ciaolib.pl:5 fatal error, invalid module name (library(prolog_sys)) should be an atom, compilation failed -- its use_module/2 directive is Ciao's own (1.4.5 the same)

pl2wam's compatibility layer for a host that is not GNU Prolog, and it defines GNU's own built-ins; gprolog 1.6.0 refuses to compile it: compat.pl:6-13 fatal error, redefining built-in predicate prolog_file_name/2, compilation failed
the SICStus shim of pl2wam, and it defines GNU's own built-ins; gprolog 1.6.0 refuses to compile it: sicslib.pl:10-11 fatal error, redefining built-in predicate g_assign/2, compilation failed
the SWI shim of pl2wam, and it defines GNU's own built-ins; gprolog 1.6.0 refuses to compile it: swilib.pl:10-11 fatal error, redefining built-in predicate callable/1, compilation failed

gprolog refuses to compile it, 1.6.0 as 1.4.5: whole.pl:3 fatal error, cannot open file bip_list.pl - does not exist, compilation failed; bip_list.pl was a file the 2001 build generated (gprolog NEWS: fix bug in pl2wam to include break/0, trace/0,... in bip_list.pl) that nothing in the current GNU source makes or ships
the YAP shim of pl2wam, and it defines GNU's own built-ins; gprolog 1.6.0 refuses to compile it: yaplib.pl:9-10 fatal error, redefining built-in predicate g_assign/2, compilation failed
